subject: science
concept: Understanding the four seasons and how they relate to changes in weather and daylight
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Earth and Space Science Disciplinary Core Ideas — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts seasonal picture cards (clothing, weather, activities) into the correct season
exercise.pictorial: Student sequences the four seasons in their repeating yearly order
exercise.abstract: Student describes typical weather and daylight patterns for a given season

misconception_flags: assumes seasons are the same everywhere in the world regardless of location

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
